query: WITH terms AS ( INSERT INTO tags (name) SELECT DISTINCT ON (lower(name)) name FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS t(name) ORDER BY lower(name) ON CONFLICT ((lower(name))) DO UPDATE SET name = tags.name RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO manifestation_tags (manifestation_id, tag_id, source_version_id) SELECT $1, id, $3 FROM terms ON CONFLICT (manifestation_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
